_comment: ArcaneDispatch relay egg. Upload a portable env generated by create-portable-env.sh, then start with ./start.sh.
name: ArcaneDispatch Relay
author: ops@arcane.art
description: Runs the ArcaneDispatch bonded relay from an uploaded portable runtime folder.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p bin data logs run
echo "Upload the ArcaneDispatch portable env contents here, then start the server."

variables.name: UDP Listen Address
variables.description: Relay UDP listen address. Use :{{server.build.default.port}} if the primary allocation is the UDP relay port.

variables.name: TCP Listen Address
variables.description: Relay TCP fallback listen address. Set this to the second allocation, for example :7778.

variables.name: Stats Listen Address
variables.description: Private stats endpoint. Keep localhost unless you know the panel network is isolated.

variables.name: TUN Enabled
variables.description: Set true only if the node container has /dev/net/tun plus NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW. Full VPN egress needs this.

variables.name: TUN Arguments
variables.description: Relay TUN config used when TUN Enabled is true.

variables.name: Relay Log Level
variables.description: Use debug while validating connectivity, info for normal operation.

variables.name: Client Name
variables.description: Auth user name to create automatically if data/auth.json is missing.
